arguments.command:
nohup bash -c '
  printf "%s\n" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> heartbeat.log
  for i in $(seq 1 10); do
    sleep 30
    printf "%s\n" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> heartbeat.log
  done
  timestamp=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
  printf "finished %s\n" "$timestamp" > done.txt
  wc -l < heartbeat.log > worker-report.txt
' >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $!
